dedupe_keys.name: usda ers season average price forecast spreadsheet models corn soybeans wheat

description: This ERS data product provides three Excel spreadsheet models that use futures prices to forecast the national season-average price received by US farmers for corn, soybeans and wheat, and the implied counter-cyclical payment rate under the 2008 Farm Act. Users can view the model forecasts or enter their own futures prices, basis values or marketing weights, with example computations on a documentation page. It is produced by the USDA Economic Research Service and listed in the data.gov catalogue. Coverage is the United States, national level. The spreadsheets are available free as Excel files; the catalogue entry shows the dataset was last updated on 10 July 2020, so it is marked stale. Caveats: the payment programme it refers to belongs to an earlier farm bill, and ERS points to the WASDE report for official price forecasts and to the Farm Service Agency for official payment rates. For simulation it shows a simple, transparent method for turning futures market signals into expected farm prices, which can be reused when modelling how market shocks from disasters or trade disruptions pass through to farm revenues. It is related to the USDA WASDE record in this catalogue, the official forecast source. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): CC0-1.0 (data.gov catalogue licence field).
